title: Test levers, the inspector and the probe CLI
steps: The status bar's right end shows the test levers in effect. This Preview's workspace starts as every Preview's notes, on the real clock.
⌘⇧P, Test levers: Reset the workspace to a scenario…, and pick tasks. The page reloads with just that scenario's notes, on 2026-10-05 at 09:00: Water the plants is due Today.
Add ?now=2026-10-07T09:00 to the address and open Chores: the same task is now due Oct 5, two days ago. Reload: the clock keeps running from where it was. ?now=real puts the real clock back.

Open the browser's console. await __commonInk.state() is the app's state as data. await __commonInk.keys("/Pay<CR>A!<Esc>") presses keys through Vim, and await __commonInk.check.overlaps() lists any chip sitting over text (none).
Reset to the extensions scenario, add ?permissions=allow, and run Show word count: it counts without a prompt, and nothing is kept in your settings. ?permissions=ask brings the prompt back.
⌘⇧P, Test levers: Go offline, or back online. Edit a note: the status bar says Offline and 1 unsent change. Run it again: the edit is sent.
Reset to the embeds scenario, add ?net=replay and open Link embeds tour: the Wikipedia and MDN cards come from recordings, not the network.

From a checkout: npm run probe -- --url <this Preview> --scenario lists --open "Lists tour" --keys "/Basil<CR>>>" --wait idle --dump cursor --screenshot out.png. COMMON_INK_URL=<this Preview> bin/common-ink reset preview puts the Preview back as it started.
